name: Four.meme launchpad liquidity migration into pre-initialized pool
summary: The launchpad's addLiquidity() migration did not check that the PancakeSwap V3 pool for the graduating token was still uninitialized, so the attacker created and initialized the pool at a manipulated sqrtPriceX96 beforehand and swapped out the BNB the launchpad then deposited.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
